data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to display Appodeal ads with consent handling.
data.what_it_does: Provides a wrapper around the Appodeal SDK to load and show Banner, MREC, Interstitial, Reward and Non‑Skippable ads. It also includes utilities for user‑consent and iOS tracking authorization.
use_when: You need to integrate Appodeal ads in a Flutter app
You require built‑in consent dialogs for GDPR/CCPA or iOS 14+ tracking
avoid_when: You prefer a maintained official package
You want to avoid the extra 64K method count or fake AdMob ID requirement
strengths: Supports all major Appodeal ad formats
Handles consent and iOS tracking permission automatically
Bundled native SDK setup (no manual Gradle/CocoaPods steps)
weaknesses: Package is archived and no longer maintained
May increase method count leading to multidex issues
Requires adding a dummy AdMob ID if AdMob is not used
data.setup_notes: Enable multidex for Android, add fake AdMob APPLICATION_ID if not using AdMob, call Appodeal.requestIOSTrackingAuthorization() on iOS 14+, set Appodeal app keys before initialization

alternatives.name: stack_appodeal_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Officially supported by Appodeal and actively maintained

alternatives.name: google_mobile_ads
alternatives.why_pick_it: General Google AdMob ads with active support and no forced AdMob ID
